  WHERE set_num = '30666-2' AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num='30666-2')
),
exploded(inv_id, part_num, color_id, qty) AS (

  SELECT e.top_set, e.part_num

  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = cs.inv_id

)

  FROM inventory_parts ip

  FROM explode e

  FROM explode e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inv WHERE set_num = e.owner)
  JOIN explode e2 ON e2.owner = im.fig_num
)

  WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),

),
expansion(root_set, inv_id) AS (
  SELECT s.set_num, cs.inv_id
  FROM sets s JOIN cur_set cs ON cs.set_num = s.set_num

  JOIN inventory_sets ns ON ns.inventory_id = e.inv_id
  JOIN cur_set cs2 ON cs2.set_num = ns.set_num

  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inv_id
  JOIN cur_fig cf ON cf.fig_num = im.fig_num
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.root_set)
FROM expansion e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inv_id
JOIN colors c ON c.id = ip.color_id

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- start from the current inventory of each set
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- recursive expansion: (set_num, part_num, color_id)
explore AS (
  -- level 0: the set's own parts
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION
  -- nested sets: recurse into the nested set's current inventory
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = c.id
  JOIN cur nc ON nc.set_num = iset.set_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = nc.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION
  -- minifigs: recurse into the minifig's current inventory
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = c.id
  JOIN inventories mf_inv ON mf_inv.set_num = imf.fig_num
  JOIN (SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn FROM inventories) mfc ON mfc.id = mf_inv.id AND mfc.rn = 1
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mfc.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.set_num
FROM explore e
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = e.part_num
JOIN colors col ON col.id = e.color_id
WHERE p.part_num = '3850' AND col.name = 'Reddish Brown'
ORDER BY e.set_num"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- start from the current inventory of each set
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- recursive expansion: (set_num, part_num, color_id)
explore AS (
  -- level 0: the set's own parts
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION
  -- nested sets: recurse into the nested set's current inventory
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = c.id
  JOIN cur nc ON nc.set_num = iset.set_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = nc.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION
  -- minifigs: recurse into the minifig's current inventory
  SELECT c.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = c.id
  JOIN inventories mf_inv ON mf_inv.set_num = imf.fig_num
  JOIN (SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn FROM inventories) mfc ON mfc.id = mf_inv.id AND mfc.rn = 1
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mfc.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.set_num
FROM explore e
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = e.part_num
JOIN colors col ON col.id = e.color_id
WHERE p.part_num = '30504' AND col.name = 'Dark Blue'

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- start from the current inventory of each set
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- recursive expansion: (top_set, inventory_id, multiplier)
explore AS (
  SELECT c.set_num AS top_set, c.id AS inv_id, 1 AS mult

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE theme_sub AS (
  SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_sub ts ON t.parent_id = ts.id
),
sets_2014 AS (
  SELECT s.set_num FROM sets s WHERE s.year = 2014 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_sub)
),
cur_inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, MAX(i.version) AS maxv
  FROM inventories i GROUP BY i.id, i.set_num
),
set_inv AS (
  SELECT ci.id AS inv_id, ci.set_num
  FROM cur_inv ci JOIN inventories i ON i.id = ci.id AND i.version = ci.maxv
),
-- minifig count per set (its own inventory, current version)
set_minifig AS (
  SELECT si.set_num, SUM(im.quantity) AS mf
  FROM set_inv si
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = si.inv_id
  GROUP BY si.set_num
),
-- nested sets per set
set_nested AS (
  SELECT si.set_num, is.set_num AS nested_set, SUM(is.quantity) AS qty
  FROM set_inv si
  JOIN inventory_sets is ON is.inventory_id = si.inv_id
  GROUP BY si.set_num, is.set_num
),
-- total minifigs per set = own + nested sets' totals (recursive)
set_total AS (
  SELECT s.set_num, COALESCE(sm.mf,0) AS own_mf
  FROM sets_2014 s
  LEFT JOIN set_minifig sm ON sm.set_num = s.set_num
)
SELECT SUM(t.own_mf + COALESCE(n.nested_mf,0)) AS total
FROM set_total t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT sn.set_num, SUM(sn.qty * st.own_mf) AS nested_mf
  FROM set_nested sn
  JOIN set_total st ON st.set_num = sn.nested_set
  GROUP BY sn.set_num
) n ON n.set_num = t.set_num"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- current inventory id per set and per minifig
cur_set AS (
  SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
),
cur_fig AS (
  SELECT fig_num, MAX(version) AS ver FROM inventories GROUP BY fig_num
),
-- start: all sets released in 2020, each exploded on its own
exploded AS (
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, s.set_num AS cur_set, NULL::VARCHAR AS cur_fig, 1 AS qty
  FROM sets s WHERE s.year = 2020
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_set, inv.set_num, NULL, e.qty * inv.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.cur_set AND i.version = (SELECT ver FROM cur_set WHERE set_num = e.cur_set)
  JOIN inventory_sets inv ON inv.inventory_id = i.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_set, NULL, inv.fig_num, e.qty * inv.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.cur_set AND i.version = (SELECT ver FROM cur_set WHERE set_num = e.cur_set)
  JOIN inventory_minifigs inv ON inv.inventory_id = i.id
)
SELECT SUM(e.qty * ip.quantity) AS total
FROM exploded e
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = '54384'
JOIN colors c ON c.name = 'Black'
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.part_num = p.part_num AND ip.color_id = c.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
JOIN inventories i ON i.id = ip.inventory_id
WHERE (e.cur_set IS NOT NULL AND i.set_num = e.cur_set AND i.version = (SELECT ver FROM cur_set WHERE set_num = e.cur_set))
   OR (e.cur_fig IS NOT NULL AND i.set_num = e.cur_fig AND i.version = (SELECT ver FROM cur_fig WHERE fig_num = e.cur_fig))"}

sets_2014 AS (
  SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2014
),
cur_inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM cur_inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- explode: each row = (root_set, part_num, color_id, qty)
exploded AS (
  -- level 0: the set's own parts
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity
  FROM cur c

  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id

  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM cur WHERE set_num = e.root_set)
  JOIN cur c2 ON c2.set_num = iset.set_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c2.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION ALL
  -- minifigs
  SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, e.quantity * ip.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM cur WHERE set_num = e.root_set)

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
sets_2013 AS (
  SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2013
),
cur_inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM cur_inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- explode: each row = (root_set, part_num, color_id, qty)
exploded AS (
  -- level 0: the set's own parts
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity
  FROM cur c
  JOIN sets_2013 s ON s.set_num = c.set_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION ALL
  -- nested sets
  SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, e.quantity * ip.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN cur c ON c.set_num = e.root_set
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = c.id AND iset.set_num = e.root_set
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  UNION ALL
  -- minifigs
  SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, e.quantity * ip.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN cur c ON c.set_num = e.root_set
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = c.id AND imf.fig_num = e.root_set
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total
FROM exploded e
JOIN cur c ON c.set_num = e.root_set
WHERE e.part_num = '63868'
  AND e.color_id = (SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'White')"}

inv_current AS (
  SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num

  JOIN inventories i ON i.id = ip.inventory_id
  JOIN inv_current ic ON ic.set_num = i.set_num AND ic.ver = i.version
  WHERE i.set_num = 'MULTIPACK-1'

  UNION
  -- nested sets
  SELECT e.part_num
  FROM explode e
  WHERE 1=0
)
SELECT 1"}

)

cur AS (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num='10221-1' AND version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num='10221-1')),

walk AS (
  -- base: the starting inventory
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM cur) AS inv_id, 0 AS depth
  UNION ALL
  -- nested sets: go to their current inventory
  SELECT i2.id, w.depth+1 FROM walk w
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id=w.inv_id

),
-- all parts in current inventory (excluding spares)

-- start from the current inventory of set 10785-1

  SELECT ci.id AS inv_id, 1 AS mult
  FROM cur_inv ci
  UNION ALL
  SELECT is2.set_num, e.mult * is2.quantity
  FROM exp e
  JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = e.inv_id

  JOIN inventories inv3 ON inv3.set_num = im2.fig_num
  WHERE inv3.id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im2.fig_num ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)
)

  SUM(CASE WHEN e.inv_id = (SELECT id FROM cur_inv) THEN ip.quantity * e.mult ELSE 0 END) AS direct_parts,

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- For each set, get its current inventory id
cur_inv AS (
  SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS ver FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num
),
inv_id AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, c.ver
  FROM inventories i JOIN cur_inv c ON i.set_num=c.set_num AND i.version=c.ver
),
-- explode(set) -> (part_num, qty) for one unit of that set, all levels, non-spare
-- We build a recursive CTE that walks the nesting tree.
-- node: (set_num, depth, mult) where mult is the product of quantities along the path
nodes AS (
  SELECT '391114-1' AS set_num, 1 AS mult
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ns.set_num, n.mult * ns.quantity
  FROM nodes n
  JOIN inv_id ii ON ii.set_num = n.set_num
  JOIN inventory_sets ns ON ns.inventory_id = ii.id
),
-- parts contributed by each node's own inventory (non-spare)
own_parts AS (
  SELECT n.set_num, n.mult, ip.part_num, ip.quantity
  FROM nodes n
  JOIN inv_id ii ON ii.set_num = n.set_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ii.id AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- minifigs: each minifig has its own inventory of parts
-- node for minifig: (fig_num, mult)
fig_nodes AS (
  SELECT '391114-1' AS set_num, 1 AS mult
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ns.set_num, n.mult * ns.quantity
  FROM fig_nodes n
  JOIN inv_id ii ON ii.set_num = n.set_num
  JOIN inventory_sets ns ON ns.inventory_id = ii.id
),
-- minifigs at each set level
figs AS (
  SELECT fn.set_num, fn.mult, imf.fig_num, imf.quantity
  FROM fig_nodes fn
  JOIN inv_id ii ON ii.set_num = fn.set_num
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = ii.id
),
-- minifig parts: each minifig's current inventory parts
fig_parts AS (
  SELECT f.set_num, f.mult * f.quantity AS mult, ip.part_num, ip.quantity
  FROM figs f
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = f.fig_num AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = f.fig_num)
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- total parts at all levels
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(mult * quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT mult, part_num, quantity FROM own_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mult, part_num, quantity FROM fig_parts
  )
),
-- parts from nested sets and minifigs only (exclude the top set's own direct parts)
nested_only AS (
  SELECT SUM(mult * quantity) AS nested_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT mult, part_num, quantity FROM own_parts WHERE set_num <> '391114-1'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mult, part_num, quantity FROM fig_parts
  )
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * nested_only.nested_qty / total.total_qty, 2) AS pct
FROM total, nested_only"}
